Significator in masculine part of heaven; named houses/oriental condition
The contrary arrangement — feminine
Age — heading
Saturn as significator — older
Jupiter, Mars or Sun as significator — adult
Mercury or Venus as significator — less old
Moon's four quarters — progressively older classifications
Oriental Moon/planet younger; occidental older
Five years per house from ascendant
Two years per descending degree in seventh house
Moon-applying planet OR chosen significator as age source
Elapsed days in month multiplied by two years
Consider most methods and pitch upon greatest number; selection method ambiguous
Forme and Stature — heading
Orientality AND Leo/Scorpio/Sagittarius — greater proportion
Occidentality OR Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces — lesser proportion
Aries/Taurus/Leo — strong upper body part
Sagittarius/Gemini/Scorpio — developed lower parts
